mapper.sql: SELECT 'POST' AS feed_type, b.post_id::TEXT AS row_id, b.title, h.hobby_id, h.name AS hobby_name, b.board_id, (SELECT u.nickname FROM member u WHERE u.member_id = b.reg_id) AS reg_name, (SELECT u.handle FROM member u WHERE u.member_id = b.reg_id) AS reg_handle, (CASE WHEN b.reg_id = #{viewerId} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS mine_yn, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment c WHERE c.post_id = b.post_id AND c.use_yn = 'Y')::INTEGER AS comment_cnt, COALESCE(b.good_cnt, 0) AS good_cnt, NULL::VARCHAR AS meet_dt, NULL::VARCHAR AS area_name, NULL::VARCHAR AS region, NULL::VARCHAR AS status_cd, NULL::VARCHAR AS status_name, NULL::INTEGER AS capacity, NULL::INTEGER AS accepted_cnt, (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_hobby uh WHERE uh.hobby_id = h.hobby_id AND uh.use_yn = 'Y' AND uh.member_id = #{viewerId}) THEN 'HOBBY' ELSE 'FOLLOW' END) AS feed_src, b.reg_dt AS sort_dt FROM post b JOIN hobby h ON h.board_id = b.board_id AND h.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE b.use_yn = 'Y' AND b.p_post_id = 0 AND b.secret_yn = 'N' AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_hobby uh WHERE uh.hobby_id = h.hobby_id AND uh.use_yn = 'Y' AND uh.member_id = #{viewerId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_follow uf WHERE uf.member_id = #{viewerId} AND uf.followee_id = b.reg_id) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM member_block ub WHERE ub.member_id = #{viewerId} AND ub.blocked_id = b.reg_id ) UNION ALL SELECT 'RECRUIT' AS feed_type, r.recruit_id::TEXT AS row_id, r.title, h.hobby_id, h.name AS hobby_name, NULL::INTEGER AS board_id, (SELECT u.nickname FROM member u WHERE u.member_id = r.reg_id) AS reg_name, (SELECT u.handle FROM member u WHERE u.member_id = r.reg_id) AS reg_handle, (CASE WHEN r.reg_id = #{viewerId} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS mine_yn, NULL::INTEGER AS comment_cnt, NULL::INTEGER AS good_cnt, r.meet_dt, (SELECT ac.name FROM code ac WHERE ac.code_id = r.area_cd AND ac.p_code_id = 'AREA00') AS area_name, r.region, r.status_cd, (SELECT sc.name FROM code sc WHERE sc.code_id = r.status_cd AND sc.p_code_id = 'RECRUIT00') AS status_name, r.capacity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recruit_apply a WHERE a.recruit_id = r.recruit_id AND a.use_yn = 'Y' AND a.apply_cd = 'APPLY02')::INTEGER AS accepted_cnt, (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_hobby uh WHERE uh.hobby_id = h.hobby_id AND uh.use_yn = 'Y' AND uh.member_id = #{viewerId}) THEN 'HOBBY' ELSE 'FOLLOW' END) AS feed_src, r.reg_dt AS sort_dt FROM recruit r JOIN hobby h ON h.hobby_id = r.hobby_id AND h.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE r.use_yn = 'Y' AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_hobby uh WHERE uh.hobby_id = h.hobby_id AND uh.use_yn = 'Y' AND uh.member_id = #{viewerId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM member_follow uf WHERE uf.member_id = #{viewerId} AND uf.followee_id = r.reg_id) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM member_block ub WHERE ub.member_id = #{viewerId} AND ub.blocked_id = r.reg_id )
mapper.select: SELECT f.feed_type, f.row_id, f.title, f.hobby_id, f.hobby_name, f.board_id, f.reg_name, f.reg_handle, f.mine_yn, f.comment_cnt, f.good_cnt, f.meet_dt, f.area_name, f.region, f.status_cd, f.status_name, f.capacity, f.accepted_cnt, f.feed_src, TO_CHAR(f.sort_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reg_dt FROM ( ) f WHERE f.feed_type = #{feedFilter} ORDER BY f.sort_dt DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( ) f WHERE f.feed_type = #{feedFilter}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_hobby WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND member_id = #{viewerId}
